market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) are a top-tier IPL franchise, winning the title in 2024 and twice earlier. In a ten-team league, a strong side typically has a 8–12% chance; the market price of 1.3% is at least five times too low. Although the 2026 season is distant, KKR's recent success and retained core give them a realistic shot far above the implied probability.
evidence_points: KKR won the 2024 IPL and have 3 titles in 17 seasons (17.6% historical title rate)
The team retained key players (e.g., Rinku Singh, Andre Russell) in the 2025 mega auction, providing stability for 2026
Implied probability of 1.3% is far below the 10% baseline for an average team and sharply below typical top-team odds (8-12%)
sources_consulted: General IPL history and 2024-2025 auction news
